Apple TV today released the trailer for the German dark comedy "Where's Wanda?" Season 2, with the show set to return to the streaming platform on October 21. Watch the trailer below.

"Where's Wanda?" returns on October 21

Nearly two years ago, "Where's Wanda?" premiered on Apple TV, telling the story of the Klatt family searching for their missing daughter Wanda.

The Klatt family grew increasingly frustrated with the pace of the police investigation, so they decided to take matters into their own hands, gradually uncovering the dark secrets of their neighbours along the way.

The first season of "Where's Wanda?" had eight episodes in total. The new season will return on October 21, also with eight episodes, releasing new episodes every Wednesday from now until December 9.
